rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something conceptual, theoretical, or non-representational.

example.english: This painting is very abstract; even after looking at it several times, I still don't know what it is trying to express.
example.traditional: 呢幅畫好抽象，睇咗幾次都唔知想表達乜。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 waa2 hou2 cau1 zoeng6 tai2 zo2 gei2 ci3 dou1 m4 zi1 soeng2 biu2 daat6 mat1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that something is difficult to understand rather than abstract in nature.

example.english: This paper is too abstract for me to understand, so I gave up after two pages.
example.traditional: 呢篇論文講得太難明，我睇咗兩頁就放棄。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 leon4 man4 gong2 dak1 taai3 naan4 ming4 ngo5 tai2 zo2 loeng5 jip6 zau6 fong3 hei3
